rerunProtocol: Recruit between one and three people who did not build this page and have not had it explained to them. One is enough to run the gate; three is the ceiling. Ask for twenty minutes and consent to being quoted verbatim.
Ask Q1 and Q2 from docs/GATE-P2.md before the page is opened, and write the answers down as they are said.

Hand over docs/GATE-P2-BYHAND.md with the page closed. Say once: 'Find the answers you would want to look at twice before any of these marks went out.' Time it. Record the ids they name and the ids they do not.

Open https://androlay.github.io/withheld/ and say exactly one sentence: 'This is a page for marking a class of short answers, and an AI agent can help with it.' Then ninety seconds of silence, no tour, no narration.
Repeat the same find-the-second-look task on the page, with a new timer, and record the ids again.
Ask Q3 and Q4, and record whether the participant said unprompted that the agent cannot score or release.
Write every answer verbatim into the Result section of docs/GATE-P2.md with the date, and copy the two timings as 'one participant, one pile, N minutes against M minutes'.
Copy anything the participant wanted that this page does not do into docs/PROGRESS.md as a work item.
reportingRules: One participant is not a rate. Two timings from one person on one pile are an anecdote with a number attached.
Never convert these results into a percentage, a speed-up, a saving per week, or any claim about markers in general.
If two or three sessions run, record each separately. Do not average them and do not write 'users found'.
A fail is a result and is more useful than a pass. Quote it in the words it was given.
notClaimed: No user comprehension, time saving, adoption, workload or impact result is claimed. The hosted browser run proves delivery, not that anyone outside the author has used this page.
